decisions.rationale: row_count 13014 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0 and the product of airport_code distinct_count 3 and observed_hour_utc distinct_count 4341 (13023) nearly matching row_count indicates each airport-hour combination appears at most once, so (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) is the most defensible grain pending measurement.

captured_at has only 3 distinct values within a one-second span (2026-09-02T23:26:11 to 2026-09-02T23:26:13), inconsistent with a per-observation attribute and consistent with a pipeline load timestamp, so it is retained and flagged for reviewer attention rather than dropped.

purpose: silver_airport_weather holds hourly weather observations for the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) from January through June 2013, combining meteorological readings (temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure, visibility) with static airport reference attributes (name, municipality, elevation, longest runway).
usage: Read the table at the (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) grain: each row is one airport's weather observation for one UTC hour. Consumers joining on airport_code can treat airport_name, airport_municipality, airport_elevation_ft, and airport_longest_runway_ft as denormalized, repeating reference attributes. Consumers must handle nulls in wind_dir_degrees, wind_speed_mph, wind_gust_mph, and pressure_mb, which are not always reported.
limitations: The profile cannot confirm the declared grain beyond row-count and distinct-count arithmetic; a deterministic measurement must verify (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) uniqueness before the grain rule is trusted. wind_gust_mph is null in roughly 75% of rows and should not be treated as consistently available. captured_at is retained as profiled with is_airbyte_metadata false, but its narrow, low-cardinality timestamp range (3 distinct values in a one-second span) suggests it is a pipeline load timestamp rather than an observation attribute, and reviewers should confirm its intended meaning. observed_date_local and observed_hour_local are locally derived fields whose relationship to observed_hour_utc, including timezone offset and DST handling, is not verified by this profile.
